$description: Anchor (platform/components/Anchor, issue 811): the sections of a page as a list of links. Each row takes NavList's item roles, as vertical Tabs do.

anchor-row-gap.$description: The space between two sections (the navigation list's).

anchor-nested-indent.$description: A subsection: how far it is indented.

anchor-radius.$description: A section row: its corners (a navigation list row's).

anchor-text.$description: A section row: its name (a navigation list row's).

anchor-font-size.$description: A section row: its name's size.

anchor-font-weight.$description: A section row: its name's weight (the current section is heavier).

anchor-min-height.$description: A section row: its least height (the standard control height).

anchor-padding-inline.$description: A section row: the space at its sides.

anchor-hover-background.$description: A section row with the pointer over it: the hover fill.

anchor-hover-shadow.$description: A section row with the pointer over it: the hover edge.

anchor-hover-text.$description: A section row with the pointer over it: its name.

anchor-current-background.$description: The current section: the selected fill (the navigation pane's current row).

anchor-current-shadow.$description: The current section: the selected edge.

anchor-current-text.$description: The current section: its name in the selected content color.

anchor-current-font-weight.$description: The current section: its name's weight.
